features.text: Medical boot design specifically sized and weighted for children ages 1-9
Durable aluminum frame suitable for kids' activity levels during recovery
Pediatric-specific rocker bottom promotes safe walking patterns
Forefoot straps ensure proper foot positioning in the medical boot
Optional built-in air system for swelling control (Wee Walker Air model)
Lightweight orthopedic boot construction for all-day comfort

measurement: Refer to our sizing chart for proper measurements, or visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for personalized fitting assistance from our medical team. Proper sizing ensures optimal healing support for growing feet.
